# Overlastic — promise-based overlays for React, Vue and Svelte

Curated by Skill Harbor — @hairyf's Overlastic skill: comprehensive guidance for the author's own promise-based modal/dialog/popup library (Overlastic v0.8.7). Teaches the agent the key concepts — overlay constructors receiving component/props/options, Deferred (a promise variant with external `confirm`/`cancel` control), mount options, lifecycle (components destroyed after the deferred resolves/rejects), and dual imperative/declarative usage — plus framework-specific references for React, Vue and Svelte, advanced patterns (OverlaysProvider context inheritance, integrating existing component libraries, external lifecycle control, declarative JSX/template usage) and per-topic `references/*.md` docs. Honest caveats: library-specific — the agent needs an Overlastic-based project to apply it to; based on the library's internal documentation, so cross-check against the published library for newer versions. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
